project_type: Full-stack community platform: Go backend with embedded SPA + React 19 frontend (SSR and SPA modes)
build_system: Make + pnpm (frontend), go build (backend). SPA build embeds into Go binary.
test_framework: Go tests (go test ./...), ESLint + TypeScript type-checking (pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck) for frontend
build_command: cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in web/ 2. Run pnpm typecheck in web/ 3. Run pnpm lint in web/
setup_instructions: 1. cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2. Ensure .env has BBSGO_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:8082
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Node 22.22.3 and pnpm 10.28.1 available. Go 1.26.0 available. No running database for backend tests but frontend type-check and lint are fully testable.
contribution_requirements: Support en-US and zh-CN locales for user-facing strings. Keep PRs focused. Include screenshots for UI changes.
key_patterns: File-based routing with @react-router/fs-routes. Components in web/components/ organized by domain. shadcn UI components in web/components/ui/. CSS in web/styles/ using Tailwind CSS 4 + custom CSS layers. i18n via i18next with messages in web/lib/i18n/messages/. API client in web/lib/api/client.ts wraps fetch with envelope parsing. LoadMore component for pagination. MainShell provides two-column layout with aside. ThemeProvider for dark/light mode. TipTap for rich text, md-editor-rt for markdown.
directory_structure: web/app/routes/ - file-based route components. web/components/ - organized by domain (ui, layout, topic, article, auth, common, editor, search, tasks, user, dashboard). web/lib/ - utilities (api, i18n, actions, router). web/styles/ - CSS files. internal/ - Go backend (handlers, services, models, cache). cmd/ - Go CLI tools.
